name: to-conformance-tlv-crc32
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.27 (a CRC-32 checksum on the tlv wire) with Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): geojson uid G-1, time_ms 1614456000000, lat 30 (lon, hae and the residue member extra have no line in the target and are not written). Output: the 16-byte key, the set length 0x1b, item 2 (00000177e5138e00), item 3 (G-1), item 13 lat 30 * 2147483647 / 90 = 715827882.333 rounds to 715827882 = 2aaaaaaa; probe.n and probe.x are absent (no item 4, and the nested set 48 with no items is not written); then the checksum item 01 04 83dfb6c3 last, counted in the set length. CRC-32 of ISO/IEC 13818-1 (poly 04c11db7, init ffffffff, MSB first, no reflection, no final XOR) over the key through the checksum item's tag and length (ruling 1 of 0.27). Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program, checked against the check values 123456789 -> 0376e6e7 and empty -> ffffffff.
